utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, nice — is the book club still meeting this week?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, it’s still on this week. Let’s keep the usual time and I’ll bring my notes.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, I’ll be there at the usual time.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what’s the book this time?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’m thinking we keep it simple and do a short mystery this time.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Nice, that sounds easy to get through. Send me the title when you pick one.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure the book club is still meeting this week?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I think so, but I’d want to double-check the time and place first. Logistics have been a little shaky lately.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, can you confirm the time and place before I show up?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the book club—sorry, I’m a little scatterbrained today. What book are we talking about?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: No worries — it’s the one we were going to read for book club this month. I can check the list if you want.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: That’d be great, thanks — I’m drawing a blank. If you check the list, I’ll probably recognize it right away.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me which book club details you want to go over first?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Uh, maybe the meeting time first? I might be a little fuzzy on the rest.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Sure — what meeting time do you have in mind, or should I help check the latest one?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late—what book are we on for the club?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No worries — we’re on "The Dutch House" this week.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh nice, I’ve heard that one’s great. I’ll catch up and be there for the discussion.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Gus — I’m happy to help with the book club. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Sam — could you bring the extra folding chairs and maybe a couple of serving trays? I’ll handle the rest for the book club.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, Gus — I’ll bring the extra folding chairs and a couple of serving trays.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I haven’t heard any book club updates yet, but I can keep an eye out for where it’s meeting.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Opal — that would be really helpful. If you hear anything about the time or place, please let me know.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Of course — I’ll keep checking and let you know as soon as I hear the time or place.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the book club? I heard they’re picking a new novel this week—pretty exciting if you ask me.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, absolutely — I’d love to join in. If you hear what they pick, let me know and I’ll spread the word too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely, I will! I’ll keep an ear out and let you know as soon as I hear what they choose.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Have you decided on the book club pick yet?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Not yet—I’m still deciding, but I should have one soon.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Any favorites you’re leaning toward?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll mention the book club plan to the others and see who’s in for the next meeting.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, that’d help a lot—I’ve been hearing bits and pieces, so I’d appreciate the update.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll ask around and share the latest with everyone. I’ll let you know who’s in for the next meeting.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Uli, I’m glad you’re here — I’m getting the book club details organized. What would you like to read together next?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’d be happy to join, Rosa. Something gentle and thoughtful would be nice — maybe a short novel or poetry.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That sounds lovely, Uli — I’ll look for a short, gentle novel or a poetry collection we can enjoy together. If you have any favorites, send them my way!

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the book club is meeting again soon—looks like they picked a new read. I should find out the details and pass them along!

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds good, Tess. Let me know the time and place, and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely—I’ll ask around and tell you as soon as I know the time and place.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Vik, sorry I’m late — did I miss anything important about the book club?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No worries — we haven’t covered much yet. We’re just talking about the next book and when to meet.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — what book are you leaning toward, and when were you thinking of meeting?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, the book club? I’d be happy to hear more about it.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It’s been a small comfort lately. I can tell you about the next meeting if you’d like.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yes, please — I’d like that.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, book club? I’m a little behind — what book are we on again?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: We’re on "The Marrow Thieves"—I think we meet at the community center on Thursday at 7.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — "The Marrow Thieves" at the community center Thursday at 7. I’ll try to make it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, the book club’s been lovely lately — everyone’s got such different takes, and it makes the chats really fun. Have you picked the next book yet?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Not yet — I want to make sure everyone’s on board before I suggest one. Do you have any favorites in mind?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I do — I’ve been thinking something a little lively but easy to discuss, like a mystery or a short novel. If you want, I can toss out a couple of options that usually get people talking.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, book club? Right — what’s the plan for this week?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m thinking we keep it simple this week—same time, bring a chapter you liked, and we can chat over tea.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sounds good to me — I’ll bring a chapter I liked and some tea. Same time still works for me.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, hey Gus — have you heard when the book club’s meeting next?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Not yet, Ira — I haven’t heard the time. If you want, I can ask around and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Morning would be better for me, thanks.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure — happy to help with the book club. What do you need?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Sam. Could you send me the list of books you’re considering?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll send you the list of books I’m considering.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but I don’t know the book club details yet—what time and where are we meeting?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’m not sure yet—do you want to pick a time and place, or should I check with everyone?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Could you check with everyone first? Once we know who can make it, I can help pick a time and place.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, I’d love to have you join us for book club—everyone’s welcome! I can send you the details and the next meeting time.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That sounds lovely, Quinn—please send me the details and the next meeting time.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’ll send them right over. We’re meeting next Thursday evening at my place, and I’ll include the book and exact time too.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can work around the school pickup time—what evening did you have in mind for book club?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — sorry, I keep mixing up the days. How about Thursday evening?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thursday works for me—I can make that after pickup. What time were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Nell — I’ve got the book club notes ready, and I’m happy to help keep us organized. What should we pick for the next read?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Rosa — I’ve been hearing good things about that mystery everyone mentioned. I’d be happy to read it next if the club’s up for it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That sounds like a great pick — I’ll put the mystery on the list and see if everyone’s on board.
